Package teilchen.util

Class TransformMatrix4f

java.lang.Object
teilchen.util.TransformMatrix4f
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class TransformMatrix4f extends Object implements Serializable
special form of a 4x4 matrix: a 3x3 matrix for rotation and scale, and a translation vector. the last row is constant. 
 | xx xy xz tx |
 | yx yy yz ty |
 | zx zy zz tz |
 |  0  0  0  1 |
transform computes R * v + t. a.multiply(b) followed by a.transform(v) applies b first, then a.

toArray and set(float[]) use the column-major order of opengl: 

 | m[0] m[4] m[ 8] m[12] |
 | m[1] m[5] m[ 9] m[13] |
 | m[2] m[6] m[10] m[14] |
 | m[3] m[7] m[11] m[15] |
toString prints the values in that order, one column per line. set(float[]) ignores the last row. the default constructor creates a zero matrix, use TransformMatrix4f(IDENTITY) for an identity. also read 'The Matrix and Quaternions FAQ' at http://www.flipcode.com/documents/matrfaq.html
